services.desc: You can schedule a computer for a maximum of 60 minutes per day at Yakima Valley Libraries locations. Computer sessions can be scheduled from a computer within the library or through the library’s web site with your library card number and password/pin. blurb: In recognition of African American History Month, Yakima Valley Libraries (YVL) is pleased to share the stories of the African American Players Club, the African Village Cultural Center, and their founders, Roho Shinda (Thelma Patillo) and Fundi Shinda (Charles Patillo). Did you know the Yakima Valley has an African Village?
